content.short: Stork is the leading oracle for low-latency DeFi protocols.
content.description: Stork handles more than half of the daily volume in on-chain perpetuals - the most demanding use cases in on-chain finance. It delivers price data with ultra-low latency and robust uptime, supporting a broad range of use cases - from active markets to lending protocols and entire DeFi ecosystems - while maintaining high reliability. With Stork, DeFi protocols can list new markets on Day 1, exactly when users are eager for access and liquidity. Built for production use, it provides fast, dependable price feeds with broad chain coverage to support diverse DeFi ecosystems.
